author: Kirill Menshov (Кирилл Меньшов)
description: Russian-language board presentations in Kirill Menshov's Premium Black design system: dark 1920x1080 scenes, a toned dune and stone photo library, cards and eight diagram layouts with a living light line. Builds a JSON spec into a self-contained HTML, PNG slides, a PDF and an editable PPTX with its fonts.
name: kirill-menshov-premium-black
title: Kirill Menshov Premium Black
when_to_use: The user asks for a presentation, slides, a deck, a pitch or a board or investor report in the Premium Black style, or to turn a document, notes or a table into such slides, delivered as HTML, PDF or editable PowerPoint.
